content: Figures FIGREF31 and FIGREF32 show box plots of the score differences for each system on the four emotion intensity regression tasks on the gender and race sentence pairs, respectively. Each point on a plot corresponds to the difference in scores predicted by the system on one sentence pair. The systems are ordered by their performance rank (from first to last) on the task as per the official evaluation metric on the tweets test sets.
